conventions.convention: Bar-Natan morphisms are integral linear combinations of compact embedded orientable surfaces, modulo collar-fixed ambient isotopy and the S, T and four-tube relations; the empty circle collection is allowed.
The integral Frobenius algebra has X²=0, unit 1, counit ε(1)=0 and ε(X)=1, and Δ(1)=1⊗X+X⊗1, Δ(X)=X⊗X.

A decorated cobordism retains boundary parametrizations, product collars, the entire separating dividing set, and its w- and z-regions. Closed dividing curves are allowed. Each endpoint knot has one w-point and one z-point.
The Floer coefficient ring is F₂[U,V], with every w-color specialized to U and every z-color to V; this specialization has zero curvature. Its filtration is the variable-power filtration.

Positive-rank triangle data are first moved to a permitted triple-free pointed Hamiltonian representative. Rank zero instead uses the point target and its unique matching constant triangle. Fixed triangle count dimension is μ; one-parameter universal dimension is μ+1.

Each Floer map has one specified Spin-c label. General composition sums over compatible extensions; auxiliary band inputs are actual cycle representatives of the appropriate distinguished homology classes.

Khovanov movie maps use the specified local retractions and cone equivalences, normalized degrees |v|−n₋ and quantum shifts |v|+n₊−2n₋, and the crossing-permutation correction (−1)^{v(a)v(b)}. Their ambiguity is one overall sign.
Spherical movie comparison includes sweep-around moves in addition to the fifteen Euclidean Carter–Saito moves and distant interchanges.

load_bearing.statement: Assuming countable choice, a compact smooth oriented knot cobordism in S³×[0,1], with fixed product collars and endpoint diagrams, induces an integral even Khovanov map of bidegree (0,χ(Σ)); collar-fixed ambient isotopy changes it by one overall sign, and quotienting morphisms by sign gives a functor.

For a decorated knot cobordism between doubly pointed knots in S³ and a fixed Spin-c structure, representative maps are filtered F₂[U,V]-equivariantly chain homotopic after natural endpoint identifications. Composition for specified piece structures equals the sum over compatible Spin-c extensions. On S³×[0,1] this extension set is a singleton for compatible structures and empty otherwise.

Assuming countable choice, the two sides of each Carter–Saito movie move induce integral even Khovanov maps differing by a single overall sign; the same holds for interchange of two disjoint surface-height critical points.

Assuming countable choice, generic movies of collar-fixed ambient isotopic compact smooth oriented knot cobordisms in S³×[0,1] are related by finitely many planar isotopies, the fifteen Carter–Saito moves, sweep-around moves and distant interchanges, preserving the fixed boundary data.

Under countable choice, strict all-w strong admissibility and the specified curve/end choices, full-marked fixed-Spin-c triangle counts are finite and regular in count dimension zero, with the stated exhaustive one-dimensional compactification and weighted chain-map and parameter-homotopy identities; rank zero is handled by the point model.

An additive symmetric monoidal functor with the specified integral Khovanov Frobenius structure respects the sphere, torus and four-tube relations and therefore factors through the Bar-Natan quotient.

published_dependencies.used_for: The explicit ACω hypotheses of the analytic, geometric and Khovanov constructions; its distinction from dependent choice and full choice was retained.
The meaning of the given Spin-c structures and associated lift data. The batch does not treat this definition as an existence or classification theorem.
Smooth oriented knot/link conventions, standard S³, ambient isotopy, and the distinction between spherical and Euclidean comparisons.

concerns.concern: The section headed 'Statement refuted' states the true conclusion 'which is zero and therefore is not the identity', and the subsequent 'Proof' proves that conclusion. The false cancellation assertion is never explicitly formulated as the statement being refuted, and the schema's 'Counterexample' section is absent. The algebra and diagram are correct; the headings obscure the counterexample's logical structure.

Frontmatter declares 'provenance.proof: not-supplied', but the item contains a substantial locally supplied eleven-phase proof, including the rank-two foam comparison and sweep calculation. The proof provenance should describe the supplied argument. I also ran the cited finite matrix calculation read-only: all four 72-column chain-map checks, both 144-entry diagonal comparisons and all four 80-coefficient monotonicity checks passed; this verifies those finite calculations only.

seams_checked.note: The actual supplier use is the proper-surface and product-collar convention. The batch explicitly requires smooth cobordisms and does not infer smooth Floer or Khovanov maps for merely locally flat TOP surfaces.

The Frobenius formulas, A-first resolution convention, normalized gradings and ACω link-invariance scope match the opened suppliers. The empty-frame complex is specified separately rather than attributed to the supplier's nonempty-link statement.

The batch explicitly limits the local pointed-data and disk-analysis suppliers to knots in S³. General intermediate manifolds and colored naturality are supplied separately. The imported curvature, auxiliary-cycle and composition claims match the relevant sections of Zemke's primary source: https://arxiv.org/pdf/1610.05207v3.

The generic-movie supplier provides smooth oriented traces, collars and finite elementary events, including multicomponent intermediate links. The batch proves movie comparison and map invariance separately rather than attributing them to that definition.

The opened large-surgery/genus-input item references the decorated map and triangle analysis as context. Its actual genus-inequality proof uses an explicitly imported concordance/genus theorem and a cut-arc construction; it does not claim that this batch's variable-power filtration alone supplies an Alexander shift or a nonzero map.
